During this story, I will present several options for [[you to choose from->instructions_2]].)////(And after I click on an option, my microphone will record the volume level for [[five seconds->instructions_3]].)////(Then this story will select the option with the [[loudest average volume->instructions_4]].)////([[Have fun->title]]!)//<div class="title">[[Let’s Build a Safe Space at the End of the World->intro_1]]</div>\It’s the end of <<linkreplace "the world" t8n>><span class="red-link">[[the fucking world->intro_2]]</span><</linkreplace>>.And the last space-builder is lying on a small rock, floating between the [[cold, blue, stars->intro_3]].They lie there, for hours and hours, until they feel ready to build a [[new safe space->intro_3_1]].They hope this space will <<linkappend "stay safe" t8n>> [[this time->intro_4]]<</linkappend>>.The builder wonders if they should start with a foundation of joy, or <span class="wrath">WRATH</span>. They summon the voices of their <<linkreplace "elders" t8n>>elders and their allies, I guess<</linkreplace>>... You tell them to build a foundation of... <<nobr>>\ <span class="choice-container pink"> • <<link "Joy">> <<run AudioChoice.record("Tell them to build a foundation of joy.", "joy", "choices_0")>> <</link>> <<if AudioChoice.getDb("choices_0", "joy") !== null>> <span class="db-result">(<<print AudioChoice.getDb("choices_0", "joy")>> dB)</span> <</if>> </span> <</nobr>>\ <<nobr>>\ <span class="choice-container"> • <<link "WRATH">> <<run AudioChoice.record("Tell them to build a foundation of WRATH.", "wrath", "choices_0")>> <</link>> <<if AudioChoice.getDb("choices_0", "wrath") !== null>> <span class="db-result">(<<print AudioChoice.getDb("choices_0", "wrath")>> dB)</span> <</if>> </span> <</nobr>>\ <<nobr>>\ <<if AudioChoice.allRecorded("choices_0")>> <div class="final-choice-container"> <<if AudioChoice.getWinner("choices_0") === "joy">> <<set $choice_0 to "joy">> <p class="winner-text pink">They will build a foundation of joy.</p> <<else>> <<set $choice_0 to "wrath">> <p class="winner-text">They will build a foundation of <span style="white-space: nowrap;"><span class="wrath">WRATH</span>.</span></p> <</if>> <div class="continue"> [[Continue->choices_0]] </div> </div> <</if>> <</nobr>>\<<if $choice_0 is "joy">>\ The builder weaves strands of ambient joy together into a [[giant pink nest->choices_0_joy_1]]. <<else>>\ The builder channels the rumbling <span class="wrath">WRATH</span> beneath the ground into a [[great black pool->choices_0_wrath_1]]. <</if>>\The nest grows, flattens, and melts into a [[sponge-like material->choices_0_joy_2]].It is soft to the touch—and will absorb [[anyone’s worries->choices_0_safe]].The pool grows like hungry mould, then solidifies into [[a tar-like mass->choices_0_wrath_2]].When the builder walks near it, it grows quivering, angry spikes. The builder whistles one of the old songs—then the spikes [[soften and retreat->choices_0_safe]].This is the foundation of a [[safe space->choices_1]].Next, the builder wonders if they should build walls of love, or <span class="wrath">WRATH</span>. You tell them to build walls of... <<nobr>>\ <span class="choice-container pink"> • <<link "Love">> <<run AudioChoice.record("Tell them to build walls of love.", "love", "choices_1")>> <</link>> <<if AudioChoice.getDb("choices_1", "love") !== null>> <span class="db-result">(<<print AudioChoice.getDb("choices_1", "love")>> dB)</span> <</if>> </span> <</nobr>>\ <<nobr>>\ <span class="choice-container"> • <<link "WRATH">> <<run AudioChoice.record("Tell them to build walls of WRATH.", "wrath", "choices_1")>> <</link>> <<if AudioChoice.getDb("choices_1", "wrath") !== null>> <span class="db-result">(<<print AudioChoice.getDb("choices_1", "wrath")>> dB)</span> <</if>> </span> <</nobr>>\ <<nobr>>\ <<if AudioChoice.allRecorded("choices_1")>> <div class="final-choice-container"> <<if AudioChoice.getWinner("choices_1") === "love">> <<set $choice_1 to "love">> <p class="winner-text pink">They will build walls of love.</p> <<else>> <<set $choice_1 to "wrath">> <p class="winner-text">They will build walls of <span style="white-space: nowrap;"><span class="wrath">WRATH</span>.</span></p> <</if>> <div class="continue"> [[Continue->choices_1_1]] </div> </div> <</if>> <</nobr>>\<<if $choice_1 is "love">>\ The builder holds their arms out, crushes some half-forgotten and unrequited love into clumps, then throws them onto the [[edges of the foundation->choices_1_love_1]]. <<else>>\ The builder runs around the foundation, pouring some pent-up <span class="wrath">WRATH</span> onto [[its edges->choices_1_wrath_1]]. <</if>>\The clumps grow like fungi, and bubble their way up [[into the sky->choices_1_love_2]].The walls are lumpy and misshapen. And they seem to be breathing. The builder is glad to be swallowed inside [[this new womb->choices_1_love_2_1]].These gentle walls need not be sturdy—they just need to <<linkreplace "hold" t8n>>[[hold space->choices_1_safe]]<</linkreplace>>.The clouds of <span class="wrath">WRATH</span> coalesce to form bleached skeletons of building frames, then [[walls of black steel->choices_1_wrath_2]].The walls stretch up like the fur of a scared animal, then they shine menacingly. They will not be breached by [[any weapon->choices_1_wrath_3]].Even in this new world, one must maintain some [[barriers of difference->choices_1_safe]].These are the walls of a [[safe space->choices_2]].Finally, the builder wonders if they should build furnishings of pride, or <span class="wrath">WRATH</span>. You tell them to build furnishings of... <<nobr>>\ <span class="choice-container pink"> • <<link "Pride">> <<run AudioChoice.record("Tell them to build furnishings of pride.", "love", "choices_2")>> <</link>> <<if AudioChoice.getDb("choices_2", "love") !== null>> <span class="db-result">(<<print AudioChoice.getDb("choices_2", "love")>> dB)</span> <</if>> </span> <</nobr>>\ <<nobr>>\ <span class="choice-container"> • <<link "WRATH">> <<run AudioChoice.record("Tell them to build furnishings of WRATH.", "wrath", "choices_2")>> <</link>> <<if AudioChoice.getDb("choices_2", "wrath") !== null>> <span class="db-result">(<<print AudioChoice.getDb("choices_2", "wrath")>> dB)</span> <</if>> </span> <</nobr>>\ <<nobr>>\ <<if AudioChoice.allRecorded("choices_2")>> <div class="final-choice-container"> <<if AudioChoice.getWinner("choices_2") === "love">> <<set $choice_2 to "pride">> <p class="winner-text pink">They will build furnishings of pride.</p> <<else>> <<set $choice_2 to "wrath">> <p class="winner-text">They will build furnishings of <span style="white-space: nowrap;"><span class="wrath">WRATH</span>.</span></p> <</if>> <div class="continue"> [[Continue->choices_2_1]] </div> </div> <</if>> <</nobr>>\<<if $choice_2 is "pride">>\ The builder walks out, takes a stone from the ground, and throws it as far away as possible. Then they turn around and raise their [[fist into the air->choices_2_pride_1]]. <<else>>\ The builder lies on the ground, flails their body around, and [[screams something wild->choices_2_wrath_1]]. <</if>>\Pillows of every colour and ancient zines and half-broken bean bags flower [[across the floor->choices_2_pride_2]].The builder will rearrange them later. One day, these furnishings will heal and enrich any body and mind, [[no matter their condition->choices_2_pride_3]].We warmth-seeking creatures must find joy out of colour and softness and language. We cannot find joy from weapons, which are doomed to be [[unhappy tools->choices_2_safe]].They know that this space does not need furnishings. Turrets from every era sprout from the walls—some are rusted, some are ivory-white, and some are golden, sparkling, [[protein crystal->choices_2_wrath_1_1]].And neon pink and green lasers slice through the air, searching for [[unbelieving flesh->choices_2_wrath_3]].If they wish to hurt us, it is best to be a stone, not a weed. It is best to always breathe into your core like you are [[preparing for a punch->choices_2_wrath_4]].No space can be safe forever. It must be maintained through an [[application of force->choices_2_safe]].So this time, this space will truly be a [[safe space->conclusion_2]].The builder is [[proud->conclusion_3]] of what they have achieved.<<set $wrath_count to [$choice_0, $choice_1, $choice_2].count("wrath")>>\ <<if $wrath_count >= 2>>\ They have created another weapon that will break the world. <<else>>\ They have created another womb where people can search for their true bodies. <</if>>\ This safe space will <<linkappend "continue to stand" t8n>>, until the next apocalypse rolls in<<timed 5.7s>><<run
